architecture_override.authority: ADR-0012 governs Logical Tunnel multipath/lifecycle; ADR-0011 governs per-lane same-association bootstrap/no-HOL.
architecture_override.critical_guard: single-flow is PER TRANSPORT LANE. Logical Tunnel product cardinality is 1..4 lanes; Normal=1 and Game/weak=2..4. Planned healthy replacement is A -> A+B bounded race -> B, candidate failure preserves A, and private replacement capacity may reach four logical lanes plus one physical candidate incarnation without creating a fifth logical lane.
architecture_override.game_semantics: First valid arrival wins, duplicates are suppressed, and bounded out-of-order unique packets deliver without cross-lane HOL in one shared Logical Tunnel PacketID namespace.
architecture_override.server_path: Shared TUN + one WBD-owned host NAT remains authoritative.
architecture_override.tcp_like_core: FakeTCP/Reality/DTLS/LINK/FEC wire is frozen unless deterministic lower-layer evidence proves a defect.
